properties.name: Sinai (Israeli-occupied)
properties.note: Sinai Peninsula occupied by Israel from June 1967 (to the east bank of the Suez Canal; an Israeli bridgehead west of the canal in Oct 1973 - Mar 1974 is not drawn). Israel pulled back from the canal under the 1974 and 1975 disengagement agreements and returned Sinai in stages under the 1979 treaty (El Arish May 1979, two-thirds by Jan 1980, the rest by 25 Apr 1982; Taba in 1989); those stages are not drawn.
properties.source: Natural Earth 1:10m admin-0 (public domain)

properties.name: Golan Heights (Israeli-occupied)
properties.note: Golan Heights captured from Syria on 9-10 June 1967 and held under military administration until the Golan Heights Law of 14 Dec 1981; drawn at the post-1974 extent (Quneitra and the Oct 1973 salient returned in June 1974). Includes the Shebaa Farms, claimed by Lebanon.
properties.source: Natural Earth 1:10m admin-0 disputed areas (public domain)

properties.name: Egypt
properties.note: Egypt west of the Suez Canal while Sinai was under Israeli occupation (June 1967 - Apr 1982); the staged Israeli withdrawals from 1974 are not drawn.
properties.source: Natural Earth 1:10m admin-0 (public domain)

properties.name: Israel-Egypt border (1979 treaty)
properties.note: International boundary recognised by the Egypt-Israel peace treaty of 26 Mar 1979 (the 1906 line from Rafah to Taba), while Sinai east of it was still being handed back in stages.
properties.source: derived from Natural Earth 1:10m polygon adjacency (public domain)

properties.name: Operation Litani area (Israeli-occupied)
properties.note: South Lebanon up to the Litani river occupied by Israel in Operation Litani (14-21 Mar 1978); the Tyre pocket was not entered. Withdrawal in stages to 13 June 1978, when the border strip was handed to Major Haddad's militia. Hand-digitised Litani line, simplified.
properties.source: hand-digitised from UN Secretary-General reports on UNIFIL (1978) and reference maps; Lebanese border edges from Natural Earth

properties.name: UNIFIL area of operations
properties.note: UN Interim Force in Lebanon (UNSC 425/426, 19 Mar 1978; first troops 23 Mar 1978) between the Litani and the Israeli-backed Haddad enclave along the border, which is excluded; the 1978 deployment also excluded the Tyre pocket. Overrun by the June 1982 invasion; UNIFIL stayed in place. Simplified (the real area was a patchwork).
properties.source: hand-digitised from UN cartographic UNIFIL deployment maps; Litani and enclave edges approximate

properties.name: 1982 invasion zone, south Lebanon (Israeli-occupied)
properties.note: Lebanon south of the Awali river held by Israel after the June 1982 invasion (Operation Peace for Galilee). Israeli forces also besieged West Beirut (June-Aug 1982) and held the Shouf until the pull-back to the Awali of 3-4 Sept 1983; they withdrew to the Litani/Nabatieh in Feb 1984 and to the "security zone" by 10 June 1985. Only the post-Sept-1983 Awali line is drawn; approximate.
properties.source: hand-digitised from UN Secretary-General reports on UNIFIL (1982-85) and press maps of the Israeli deployment; Lebanese border edges from Natural Earth

properties.name: Israel
properties.note: Israel within the 1949 armistice lines (Green Line), including the Latrun no-man's land held since 1967. Excludes East Jerusalem and the Golan, drawn as separate annexed zones.
properties.source: Natural Earth 1:10m admin-0 (public domain)

properties.name: West Bank (Israeli-occupied)
properties.note: West Bank under Israeli military occupation since June 1967 (East Jerusalem excluded, see annexed zone).
properties.source: Natural Earth 1:10m admin-0 (public domain)

properties.name: East Jerusalem (annexed by Israel)
properties.note: East Jerusalem and surrounding villages (~70 km2, including the former no-man's land and Mount Scopus) placed under Israeli law and administration on 28 June 1967; annexation not recognised internationally.
properties.source: Natural Earth 1:10m admin-0 disputed areas (public domain)

properties.name: Golan Heights (annexed by Israel)
properties.note: Golan Heights captured from Syria in June 1967 and placed under Israeli law by the Golan Heights Law of 14 Dec 1981 (not recognised internationally; the UN considers it occupied Syrian territory). Includes the Shebaa Farms, claimed by Lebanon.
properties.source: Natural Earth 1:10m admin-0 disputed areas (public domain)

properties.name: Gaza Strip (Israeli-occupied)
properties.note: Gaza Strip under Israeli military occupation from June 1967.
properties.source: Natural Earth 1:10m admin-0 (public domain)

properties.name: South Lebanon "security zone" (Israeli-occupied)
properties.note: Strip of south Lebanon (~850-1,100 km2) held by Israel and the South Lebanon Army from the completion of the 1985 withdrawal (10 June 1985) until the Israeli withdrawal of 24 May 2000. Northern edge hand-digitised (Beit Yahoun - Beaufort - Marjayoun - Hasbaya); the SLA-held Jezzine salient is not drawn. Simplified.
properties.source: hand-digitised from UN Secretary-General reports on UNIFIL and reference maps of the security belt; Lebanese border edges from Natural Earth

properties.name: UNIFIL area of operations
properties.note: UN Interim Force in Lebanon (est. UNSC 425/426, March 1978) area of operations between the Israeli "security zone" and the Litani, 1985-2000; simplified (the actual area was a patchwork and excluded the Tyre pocket).
properties.source: hand-digitised from UN cartographic UNIFIL deployment maps; Litani and security-zone edges approximate

properties.name: UNDOF area of separation
properties.note: UN Disengagement Observer Force area of separation between the Israeli-held Golan and Syria under the 31 May 1974 disengagement agreement (Alpha and Bravo lines).
properties.source: Natural Earth 1:10m admin-0 disputed areas (public domain)

properties.name: Lebanon
properties.source: Natural Earth 1:10m admin-0 (public domain)

properties.note: Syria excluding the Israeli-held Golan Heights.
properties.source: Natural Earth 1:10m admin-0 (public domain)

properties.name: Egypt
properties.note: Egypt including Sinai, returned by Israel by 25 April 1982 (Taba in 1989).
properties.source: Natural Earth 1:10m admin-0 (public domain)

properties.name: 1949 armistice line (Green Line, Israel-West Bank)
properties.note: The 1949 Israel-Jordan armistice line around the West Bank, crossed by Israel in June 1967; runs west of annexed East Jerusalem.
properties.source: derived from Natural Earth 1:10m polygon adjacency (public domain)

properties.name: 1949 armistice line (Israel-Gaza Strip)
properties.note: The 1949 Israel-Egypt armistice line around the Gaza Strip, now the fenced perimeter.
properties.source: derived from Natural Earth 1:10m polygon adjacency (public domain)

properties.name: Israel-Egypt border
properties.note: International boundary (1906 line) restored by the 1979 peace treaty when Israel completed its withdrawal from Sinai on 25 April 1982.
properties.source: derived from Natural Earth 1:10m polygon adjacency (public domain)

properties.name: Gaza Strip-Egypt border
properties.note: Boundary between the Gaza Strip and Egypt (Rafah / "Philadelphi" corridor).
properties.source: derived from Natural Earth 1:10m polygon adjacency (public domain)

properties.name: Israel-Lebanon armistice line (1949)
properties.note: 1949 Israel-Lebanon armistice line, following the 1923 Mandate boundary; superseded for UN purposes by the Blue Line in June 2000.
properties.source: derived from Natural Earth 1:10m polygon adjacency (public domain)

properties.name: Golan ceasefire line (1974 Alpha line)
properties.note: Israeli forward line under the 1974 Israel-Syria disengagement agreement; the UNDOF area of separation lies east of it.
properties.source: derived from Natural Earth 1:10m polygon adjacency (public domain)

properties.name: Israel-Jordan armistice line (1949)
properties.note: 1949 armistice line between Israel and Jordan outside the West Bank (Yarmouk, Dead Sea, Arava), following the Mandate-era boundary.
properties.source: derived from Natural Earth 1:10m polygon adjacency (public domain)

properties.name: Jordan River line (West Bank-Jordan)
properties.note: 1967 ceasefire line along the Jordan river and the Dead Sea between the Israeli-occupied West Bank and Jordan; Jordan relinquished its claim to the West Bank in 1988.
properties.source: derived from Natural Earth 1:10m polygon adjacency (public domain)
